data.current_description:
Cancel a previously applied recharge.

## INACTIVE Account Behavior
- Full reversal of recharge
- Code returned to inventory
- Code can be reused
- `codeReturnedToInventory: true`

## ACTIVE Account Behavior
- Deduct time only (cannot reverse)
- Code NOT returned to inventory
- Code cannot be reused
- `codeReturnedToInventory: false`
data.summary_suggestion: Cancel recharge with account state-dependent behavior
data.description_suggestion: Cancels a previously applied recharge with behavior dependent on account state. For INACTIVE accounts: performs full reversal of the recharge, returns the recharge code to inventory for reuse, and sets codeReturnedToInventory to true. For ACTIVE accounts: deducts the recharge time from the account (cannot fully reverse), does not return the code to inventory, and sets codeReturnedToInventory to false. Requires platformEndUserId and partnerUserId (validated for match) and a unique requestId. Returns the cancellation status, codeReturnedToInventory flag, and updated account validity period.
